title: Not Downloading Anything
subheading: Quick fix for when the downloader or Spotify is not downloading anything.

contents.Text: The downloader or Spotify finishes without downloading anything.
Make sure [[[strong:YT_dlp_args]]] is set to profile [[[strong:1]]] or profile [[[strong:3]]] in both of these places:
[[[strong:Downloader -> Playlist Editor:]]] Open your key and check [[[strong:YT_dlp_args]]].
[[[strong:Downloader -> Settings:]]] This is where the Spotify options are. Check [[[strong:YT_dlp_args]]] there too.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The profile numbers start counting from [[[strong:zero]]], so the list is 0, 1, 2, 3.
[[[strong:Profile 1]]] is called [[[strong:downloads best audio then converts to format (slower)]]].
[[[strong:Profile 3]]] is called [[[strong:downloads best audio then converts to format (slower) without embedding thumbnails]]].
These two basically do the same thing, one just without thumbnails. They are generic, so they will take any input and convert it to the output you choose.
Profiles 0 and 2 are [[[strong:direct downloads]]]. The website must support that exact codec and container for them to download anything.
They are faster, but they require the user to be a bit more advanced, so if you are unsure, use profile 1 or 3.
For more information on args, see the [[[button:Advanced args page][/Main Window/Downloader/Playlist Editor/YT_dlp_args]]] page.
